steps.note: Reach the single-stage auction creation flow.
Allow participants to be added during creation.
Change the event type to Auction.
Supply a title so missing-title validation cannot mask the tick-size refusal.
Add the specified product and quantity.
Complete the other required pricing-sheet fields.
Verify the location selection was retained.
Add two QA vendors for the case's Vendor A and Vendor B roles.
Commit the Start now schedule with a 30-minute duration.
Complete any remaining mandatory fields without changing the zero tick size.
Attempt publishing and require the specific tick-size refusal, not an unrelated validation error.
